terms.gloss: enter, record (in accounts or a register; on a computer)
evidence: Cic. Rosc. Com. 4: nōmen in tabulās, in cōdicem (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 261: in computātrum referre, enter (on a computer)
terms.comment: Classically to enter in the accounts or a register (in tabulās referre); Traupman keeps the verb for the computer.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 261, 310, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).
Citations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them and have not been checked against an edition.
